constraints.name: initial_configuration
constraints.description: Exactly n^2 friends start in the top-left n×n region, one per cell.
constraints.formal: ∀x,y ∈ [1,n] : cell (x,y) contains exactly one friend; all other cells are empty.

constraints.name: target_configuration
constraints.description: After all moves, the bottom-right n×n region must contain exactly one friend per cell.

constraints.name: move_operations
constraints.description: Allowed moves are cyclic row shifts (all friends in a row move left or right with wrapping) and cyclic column shifts (up or down with wrapping).

constraints.name: obstacle_constraint
constraints.description: At no point during the sequence of moves may any friend occupy a cell that still contains snow; becoming ill is forbidden.

constraints.name: obstacle_removal
constraints.description: Before any move, you may pay c_{x,y} to permanently remove snow from cell (x,y); any number of cells can be cleared.
constraints.formal: Choose set S of cells; total cost = Σ_{(x,y)∈S} c_{x,y}.

constraints.name: start_no_snow
constraints.description: The entire initial n×n top-left region is guaranteed to have no snow.

constraints.name: objective_min_removal_cost
constraints.description: Minimize the total coin cost of snow removals such that there exists a sequence of moves driving all friends to the target region without ever occupying an unsnowed cell.
